title: One policy for a planning service's jobs
heading: One Object Decides the Device, Solver, Method, Threads and Tolerance
cases: a published answer runs on one CPU thread on every machine
a large LP goes to the GPU when there is one, and a small one stays on the CPU
a GPU without cuOpt keeps a MILP on the CPU
an LP of exactly the threshold size counts as large
CPU threads never exceed the machine's cores
every GPU branch is verified on the CPU
